answer: An agent economy resists sybils by bonding identities to a shared ablation budget, where each new agent must post collateral calibrated to the boundary-layer heat flux at its claimed knoll of reputation. Colluders who forge identities drive the collective bond pool toward its nadir, since every fabricated identity consumes finite thermal margin and triggers cross-checked. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
